lines.text: Don't worry, it's my treat tonight.

data.define: Used to say you will pay for the others.

example.text: Don't worry, it's my treat tonight.

misuse.text: Don't say 'my treat' if you can't pay.
misuse.why: Everyone expects you to cover it.

publish.title: What does "my treat" mean?
publish.value: My treat = I'll pay for this. Example: "Don't worry, it's my treat tonight." (casual English).
